title: Don't Wait, Django... Shoot!
description: Django believes there is only one path for him to follow when he returns to his hometown and discovers his father has been murdered by a ruthless gang.

title: Sugar Colt
description: A cowboy disguises himself as a doctor to investigate disappearances and avenge a friend.

title: Pistol for a Hundred Coffins
description: A Civil War veteran swears revenge when he returns home to find his family killed by a local gang.

title: Trusting Is Good... Shooting Is Better
description: A robbery gone awry due to the death of the bandit leader has three of the robbers trying to obtain the loot.

title: The Treasure of Silver Lake
description: A frontiersman and his American Indian comrade must stop bandits from pillaging tribal lands in their search for riches.

title: Ride in the Whirlwind
description: Cowboys Wes (Jack Nicholson), Vern (Cameron Mitchell) and Otis (Tom Filer) are journeying through Texas when they have the unfortunate luck of meeting a gang of robbers who have just held up a stagecoach and lynched the driver. The local sheriff's posse surrounds them before they can get away, and Wes and his friends are unable to convince the lawmen they're not part of the gang. After a fierce shootout, Wes and Vern flee -- with the vigilante sheriff hot on their trail.

title: Go With God, Gringo
description: After he's framed for murder, Gringo needs to prove his innocence and save his woman.

title: California
description: A Union soldier travels to his deceased friend's home to return his belongings. He falls for his friend's sister, but the ghosts of the war return to haunt him.

title: Day of Anger
description: A poor street cleaner is relentlessly bullied by the people of a small western township, but things change when a ruthless gunfighter rides into the town.

title: Patience Has a Limit, We Don't
description: An Irish corporal in a U.S. army camp steals and hides the military's treasure chest. When he dies, his two half-wit sons set out to find it.

title: Lone and Angry Man
description: A man (Antonio De Teffe) joins a vicious gang of highwaymen after passing a deadly initiation. When the gang members suspect that he is a traitor, he turns on the degenerate men and seeks vengeance.

title: $100,000 for Ringo
description: Lee Barton arrives in a small town and is mistaken for a local killed during the Civil War. He soon battles with a local boss as they race to find a fortune left hidden by a Mexican general.

title: There's A Noose Waiting For You...Trinity!
description: Trinity, an ex-gunslinger, desperately wants to be forgiven and accepted by his family after he abandoned them. A ruthless bounty hunter tracks Trinity down and forces him to return to face justice for his crimes.

title: For One Thousand Dollars Per Day
description: After his parents are murdered by the Clark brothers, a man gets help from famous gunman Carranza and trains himself to become the best shot in the West to get rid of the killers and avenge his family.

title: Twice a Judas
description: A wealthy amnesiac becomes aware of a con man's attempts to kill off his family and separate him from his estate.

title: Buddy Goes West
description: Two outlaws help villagers fight a gang and a corrupt sheriff after gold is discovered under a village.

title: Wanted
description: A sheriff goes on the run after he is unjustly accused of murder.

title: Two Brothers in Trinity
description: After inheriting a land plot in a dusty place called Trinity, the antagonistic half-brothers, Lester and Jesse, reunite to pursue different aspirations, only to find themselves neck-deep in trouble.

title: Rattler Kid
description: An unjustly condemned soldier escapes and seeks justice as an outlaw.

title: Trinity and Sartana Are Coming
description: A horse thief and his Trinidadian partner defeat the notorious El Tigre and become heroes.

title: The Restless Breed
description: Texas-border gunrunners kill a federal agent, whose son (Scott Brady) comes looking for revenge.

title: One Damned Day at Dawn... Django Meets Sartana!
description: A young man arrives in the small desert town of Black City to assume the vacant sheriff's position, much to the distaste of a Mexican bandit leader. Complications arise when a famous bounty hunter shows up in town.

title: A Taste of Killing
description: Tasked with guarding a bank's gold supply, a man (Craig Hill) comes up against a vicious gang determined to steal it.

title: Two Crosses at Danger Pass
description: Killing leads to more killing, starting with the sheriff and an innocent prisoner.
